gap_identification.response:
Based on this meta-analysis, I have identified the following research gaps:

1. POPULATION GAPS: Most studies (78%) focus on adult populations. Only 3 studies included pediatric participants. No studies examined elderly populations (>75 years).

2. INTERVENTION VARIATIONS: All studies used standard dosing. No studies examined dose-response relationships or personalized dosing strategies.

3. LONG-TERM OUTCOMES: Follow-up periods ranged from 3-12 months. No studies examined outcomes beyond 1 year.

4. METHODOLOGICAL GAPS: Limited use of active comparators. Most studies used placebo controls rather than comparing to existing treatments.

5. GEOGRAPHIC DIVERSITY: 92% of studies conducted in Western countries. Underrepresented: Asia, Africa, South America.
